Stage 01

The free content

Everything I publish for free. No sign-up, no homework. Pick whichever format you prefer (listening, reading, or watching) and start there.

The Stuck Not Broken podcast

A weekly podcast on Polyvagal Theory and trauma, without psychobabble or woo-woo.

Free

Stage 02

Free, but with structure

I have a lot of content and it might feel scattered. The options below organize everything for you.

Mindful Moments

A live, guided practice to connect with the present moment, led by me. Anyone can join and there is no participation necessary. ~20 minutes.

Free

Trauma & the Polyvagal Paradigm

A short ebook explaining how trauma and the polyvagal paradigm fit together. The piece to read first if you want the theory in one sitting.

Free

I hear from people all the time who tell me they love my free content and take it in to help them sleep, get some soothing, or get clarity on their next steps. There’s enough free stuff to take in for months. Years, even. And there is nothing wrong with that at all. Take your time. I am honored to connect with you in this way and I hope you get everything you need.

But you might be ready for something else.

Stage 03

Paid and self-paced

These go even deeper and more focused than my free content, with more guidance. The free stuff is great for learning what, but it doesn’t teach you how. The paid options teach what, and how, and even guide you through it. All of these options are self-paced, solo, and perfect for the person who is self-motivated and doesn’t need to connect with others.

The Stuck Not Broken book series

Books that go deeper than the podcast: building safety, getting unstuck, and the language to make sense of your own nervous system.

From $10 ebook
$20 softcover
Get →

The Stuck Not Broken app

A self-regulation practice built entirely for you. You check in, and it builds a custom meditation for the state you’re actually in, adapting every time you return. Free to use, no card.

Free

An AI coach trained on my teaching and tuned to you. It builds a personalized practice for your nervous system, and adapts as you change.

Stage 04

Live practice and community

For when you want other people in this with you: weekly live events with me, small groups, and a community practicing the same things you are.

Unstucking Academy: Co-Regulator tier

Everything in the Self-Regulation tier, plus weekly live events with me, small-group cohorts, direct access for accountability, the Stuck Not Broken app, and all three books as PDFs. The full Academy experience.

$39 /mo
Get →
Stage 05

Working with me one-to-one

You can make incredible progress using the free and paid options above. But sometimes, you need just a little extra. When you work with me 1:1, you will get all my knowledge and focus applied to you and your wonderful nervous system. We make a custom goal and homework assignments for you that are realistic and designed for progress.

I don’t offer packages or minimums. You’re welcome to meet with me once to get my input and feedback about your current efforts.

Therapy (LMFT)

1:1, couples, or family therapy with me as a Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist specializing in trauma. California residents only. Insurance not accepted.

$150 /session
Book →

Coaching

1:1 sessions with me. In one session, we’ll build your custom unstucking plan by reviewing your concerns, current efforts, safety level, stuck defensive state, goals, and homework. If the first session felt right, we can meet again. Zero pressure or expectations.

$150 /session
Book →

Professional consultation

For therapists and practitioners who want to apply Polyvagal Theory to specific clients. Bring a case, leave with a direction.

$200 /session
Book →

Speaking engagements

Talks, workshops, and trainings for organizations, conferences, and teams. Topics tailored to your audience.

By request
